ideas.pitch: An edge-AI hardware device using microcontrollers and low-power sensors to detect early-stage crop stress and pest infestations without needing continuous cloud connectivity.
ideas.title: KrishiKavach: Offline-First Agri-Sensor and Pest Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines an unusual physical hardware build with local inference on microcontrollers, standing out heavily against a room full of standard web wrappers.

ideas.pitch: A mobile-first transactional voice agent that understands regional dialects and complex local idioms, automatically generating catalog listings and processing invoices for rural artisans.
ideas.title: BhashaBazaar: Vernacular Voice Commerce Assistant for Local Artisans
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses grassroots digital inclusion directly in India, hitting the core societal impact metric that judges at 'Build for Bharat' events prioritize above generic tech.

ideas.pitch: A sensor rig that clips onto local utility transformers to monitor temperature anomalies and oil degradation, using edge anomaly detection to prevent localized blackouts.
ideas.title: GridGuardian: Low-Cost IoT Power Transformer Health Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes a closed-loop anomaly detection pipeline combined with an industrial hardware application, echoing winning patterns from infrastructure hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A classroom hardware server utilizing a localized Wi-Fi mesh to stream interactive STEM modules and instantly grade offline quizzes for remote schools with poor internet.
ideas.title: Pathshala-Edge: Offline Localized Learning and Quiz Mesh
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly solves last-mile infrastructure hurdles in India, presenting a deeply practical educational tool that delivers a live, fault-tolerant demo in the room.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight patient health record aggregator that parses messy prescription photos via specialized OCR and maps them securely to national health ID formats.
ideas.title: SwasthyaLedger: Interoperable PHR Aggregator for Ayushman Bharat
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves real integration pain points within India's public digital health architecture, appealing strongly to judges looking for scalable government ecosystem tools.
